0022600183.text: The Trail Blazers (5-1, 1st in the Northwest, 3rd in the West) are on a two-game winning streak and have gone 4-0 on the road, while the Phoenix Suns (1-4, 12th in the West) have lost three straight. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and has Jordan Goodwin listed as day-to-day with a calf injury and a game-time decision. Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 124-83 win in Portland on October 21, and the Trail Blazers lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
